vectors.name: slot/password-test-params
vectors.description: Password slot with TEST-ONLY Argon2id parameters (64 KiB, 2 passes, 2 lanes); a reader must refuse these outside test vectors.

vectors.name: slot/password-test-params-open
vectors.description: Open it with the password.

vectors.name: slot/password-wrong-password
vectors.description: Wrong password.

vectors.name: slot/password-refused-outside-tests
vectors.description: The same slot is refused when not running test vectors: below 65536 KiB and 2 passes.

vectors.name: slot/password-nfc
vectors.description: Password "e" + combining acute (NFD). It is normalised to NFC before hashing, so the precomposed spelling opens the same slot.

vectors.name: slot/password-nfc-open-precomposed
vectors.description: Open the NFD slot with the NFC spelling.

vectors.name: slot/password-default-params
vectors.description: Password slot with the default Argon2id parameters: 131072 KiB, 3 passes, 4 lanes.

vectors.name: slot/password-default-params-open
vectors.description: Open it, without the test-only allowance.

vectors.name: kit/text
vectors.description: The printed form of a 20-byte recovery kit: RK1- and 32 Crockford base32 characters in groups of four, hyphen-separated (the separator is not in the spec).

vectors.name: kit/parse
vectors.description: Reading the printed form back.

vectors.name: kit/parse-lowercase-and-confusables
vectors.description: Lower case, spaces for hyphens, and O/I/L for 0/1/1 (Crockford decoding; not in the spec).

input.text: rk1-bppd rme7 xhox y4jf hk98 th7n gs2d gfgn

vectors.name: kit/parse-bad-prefix
vectors.description: Wrong prefix.

vectors.name: kit/parse-short
vectors.description: Thirty-one characters.

vectors.name: slot/kit
vectors.description: Recovery kit slot.

vectors.name: slot/kit-open
vectors.description: Open with the kit.

vectors.name: slot/kit-open-wrong-kit
vectors.description: Another kit.

vectors.name: slot/kit-open-tampered-header
vectors.description: One bit of the slot map changed: the map is the aad.

vectors.name: slot/device-seal-fixed
vectors.description: Device slot sealed to a device X-Wing key, with fixed KEM randomness (deterministic).

vectors.name: slot/device-open
vectors.description: The device opens its slot with its X-Wing seed.

vectors.name: slot/device-open-wrong-device
vectors.description: Another device's key.

vectors.name: slot/wrong-unlock-type
vectors.description: A password offered to a device slot.

vectors.name: slot/device-forged-ps
vectors.description: Anyone who knows a device's public key can seal garbage to it. The slot claims alice's pid but holds another secret; a reader must check (not in the spec).

vectors.name: slot/device-forged-ps-open
vectors.description: Opening yields a secret that does not derive the slot's pid.
